name: edit_metadata
description: Single constructor for metadata, forms, DCS, templates, extensions, reports. Pass operation=<name> with operation-specific parameters. Call operation=help for the full catalog (167 operations across 10 groups: Objects 21, Specialized 29, Command interface 6, Services HTTP/SOAP 9, Forms 33, Templates 6, BusinessProcess route map 4, Extensions 5, DCS 51, Common 3), operation=help topic=parameters for the full rules of the parameters. Add dryRun=true to any operation to preview changes without applying them. Supports: idempotent skip with propertyMismatch tag, cascade form cleanup (cascadeForms=true), object commands, form command-interface items, picture validation, batch operations, and multi-language synonyms.

operation.description: Operation name. Use 'help' to list available operations and topics.

ownerFqn.description: FQN of the owning metadata object.

property.description: The reference property to change. add / remove_object_reference take a LIST-valued one, set / clear_object_reference a SCALAR one. Full text: operation=help topic=parameters.

valueFqn.description: FQN of the referenced object, for the reference and content operations.

autoRecord.description: add_exchange_plan_content: per-item auto change registration - Deny (default) or Allow.

use.description: add_common_attribute_content: per-object usage of the common attribute - Auto (default), Use or DontUse. Schema parameter: Auto or Always.

valueListAllowed.description: Schema parameter accepts a value list.

subsystems.description: set_subsystems_order: comma-separated top-level subsystems in the wanted leading order.

subsystem.description: The subsystem whose command interface or section visibility to change.

command.description: The command to place or show: CommonCommand.X or an object command such as Catalog.X.Command.Y.

group.description: create_object_command / set_command_placement / set_command_order: the command group - a friendly name, a platform token, or CommandGroup.<name>. Full text: operation=help topic=parameters.

commands.description: set_command_order: JSON array of command FQNs in the wanted leading order. set_excluded_commands: JSON array of standard command names, case-insensitive; empty clears the exclusions under mode=replace.

visible.description: true shows, false hides, for the visibility operations.

role.description: Optional Role FQN for the visibility operations: sets that one role's value instead of the common, role-independent one.

objectType.description: English-singular metadata type for createObject (e.g. Catalog, Document).

name.description: Name of the new element (createObject / addObjectAttribute / ...).

synonym.description: Synonym for a newly created object or field.

properties.description: create_object: a JSON object of property name to value, applied in the creating transaction.

externalConnection.description: create_object CommonModule: the External connection context.

clientOrdinaryApplication.description: create_object CommonModule: the Client (ordinary application) context.

serverCall.description: create_object CommonModule: whether server procedures are callable from the client.

global.description: create_object CommonModule: the Global flag. Not an execution context on its own.

propertyValue.description: Text/JSON; localized: default-language text or language map. help topic=parameters.

listMode.description: List operation: replace (default), add, remove, clear.

type.description: Type for the attribute-creating operations and set_object_type: String / Number / Date / Boolean / UUID, CatalogRef.X, or several comma-separated. Full text: operation=help topic=parameters.

multiLine.description: Multi-line input mode for the attribute (BasicFeature.multiLine). Optional.

length.description: Maximum length for type=String / type=BinaryData (0 = unlimited). Default 0. Optional.

precision.description: Total digit count for type=Number. Default 10. Optional.

fractionDigits.description: Digits after the decimal point for type=Number. Default 0. Optional.

nonNegative.description: Restrict type=Number to non-negative values (AllowedSign=Nonnegative). Default false. Optional.

dateFractions.description: Date / DateTime / Time (DateFractions) for type=Date. Default Date. Optional.

allowedLength.description: Variable / Fixed (AllowedLength) for type=String. Default Variable. Optional.

fillChecking.description: Fill-check mode for a new field: DontCheck or ShowError.

fullTextSearch.description: addObjectAttribute / addTabularSectionAttribute / addRegisterField: full-text search usage. DontUse | Use. Optional.

indexing.description: Index mode for a new field: DontIndex, Index or IndexWithAdditionalOrder.

toolTip.description: addObjectAttribute / addTabularSectionAttribute / addRegisterField: tooltip text (localized, stored under 'ru').

formFqn.description: FQN of the form for form operations (e.g. Catalog.Users.Form.ItemForm, CommonForm.X.Form).

itemPath.description: set_excluded_commands: whose exclusions to change - the form (empty or Form), FormCommandPanelGlobalCommands, or a form item as Item.<name> or <name>.

mode.description: set_excluded_commands: replace (default), add or remove. add and remove need at least one name in commands.

itemNames.description: add_form_appearance_rule: form items to style, comma-separated; omitted = whole form.

field.description: add/remove_form_appearance_rule: data path the condition reads (Объект.Флаг).

keyParameter.description: add_form_parameter: mark the parameter as a key parameter (FormParameter.keyParameter). Default false.

formType.description: Form type for createForm: ORDINARY or MANAGED (default MANAGED). Legacy purpose values are normalized to MANAGED.

layout.description: Form layout for createForm: auto (typed defaults) / empty (manual layout) / standard.

purpose.description: create_form: which form the EDT generator should build - ItemForm, ListForm, ChoiceForm, FolderForm, RecordSetForm, RecordForm, Generic. Full text: operation=help topic=parameters.

setAsDefault.description: Set this form as the owner's default form (createForm).

templateType.description: Template type for addTemplate: SpreadsheetDocument / TextDocument / BinaryData / ActiveDocument / GraphicalSchema / DataCompositionSchema / DataCompositionAppearanceTemplate / GeographicalSchema / HTMLDocument / AddIn.

content.description: Plain-text body of a TextDocument or HTMLDocument template - filled on create, replaced by set_template_content, returned by get_template_content. Full text: operation=help topic=parameters.

points.description: create_route_map: JSON array of route points, laid out top to bottom.

bpFqn.description: create/get/remove_route_map: BusinessProcess FQN (alias of ownerFqn), e.g. BusinessProcess.Order.

overwrite.description: create_route_map: replace an existing Flowchart.scheme (default false - refuses to clobber).

addressingRegister.description: set_task_addressing: InformationRegister FQN the task is addressed in.

addressingAttributes.description: set_task_addressing: JSON array of {name,type,dimension} the task addresses by.

mainAddressingAttribute.description: set_task_addressing: the attribute that addresses the task (name or FQN).

currentPerformer.description: set_task_addressing: SessionParameter FQN the current performer comes from.

tabularSection.description: Tabular section name for addTabularSectionAttribute / removeTabularSectionAttribute (alias of tabularSectionName).

tabularSectionName.description: Tabular section name for TS operations.

rootURL.description: create_http_service: root URL of the service (no leading slashes - platform rejects them). Default = '<name>'.

reuseSessions.description: create_http_service: reuse HTTP sessions across requests.

sessionMaxAge.description: create_http_service: session max age in seconds (optional).

commandParameterType.description: create_object_command: the type of the command's parameter (e.g. CatalogRef.X). Written as a type description, and a name that resolves to nothing fails the call instead of landing silently as nothing.

dataObjectName.description: add_data_set with dataSetType=Object: the object that dataset reads. Required there, refused on any other dataset type.

conditionType.description: add_conditional_appearance / add_appearance: the comparison of the filter - Equal by default. A partial condition is refused: conditionValue without field and field without conditionValue land nowhere.

conditionValue.description: add_conditional_appearance / add_appearance: the value the condition compares the field against.

appearance.description: add_conditional_appearance / add_appearance / set_data_set_field_appearance: 'Name=Value;Name=Value' - TextColor, BackColor, BorderColor, Font, Format or their Russian equivalents.

urlTemplateName.description: create_http_service: name of the initial URLTemplate. Default 'Template1'.

urlTemplate.description: create_http_service / add_url_template: URL pattern with leading slash (e.g. '/clients/{id}').

methodName.description: create_http_service: name of the initial Method. Default 'Get'.

handler.description: Handler procedure: a name for the HTTP-service operations, a CommonModule.<Module>.<Method> reference for set_event_subscription.

source.description: set_event_subscription: comma-separated source value-type FQNs, e.g. 'DocumentObject.X,InformationRegisterRecordSet.Y,ConstantValueManager.Z,DefinedType.W'. Replaces the subscription source.

event.description: The event to handle. set_event_subscription takes a platform event (BeforeWrite, OnWrite, Posting...), the form operations take a form event; Russian names are accepted.

createModule.description: create_http_service: write Module.bsl for the service. Default true.

withHandlerStub.description: create_http_service / create_web_service: insert a stub handler procedure into Module.bsl. Default true.

template.description: add_url_template: URL pattern (alias of urlTemplate for older call sites).

operationName.description: create_web_service: name of the initial Operation (default 'Default'). add_operation_parameter: name of the existing Operation to add the parameter to.

returningValueType.description: add_web_service_operation: XDTO return value type as QName: '{nsUri}localName' or a bare local name with returningValueTypeNs (default XSD namespace). Given none, the XSD string type. HTTP services are untyped.

returningValueTypeNs.description: add_web_service_operation: namespace URI for returningValueType when given as a bare local name.

valueType.description: add_operation_parameter: XDTO parameter value type as a QName - '{nsUri}localName' or a bare local name + valueTypeNs (default XSD namespace).

valueTypeNs.description: add_operation_parameter: namespace URI for valueType when given as a bare local name.

transferDirection.description: add_operation_parameter: parameter direction IN / OUT / IN_OUT. Default IN. Optional.

nillable.description: add_operation_parameter: whether the parameter accepts a null (xsi:nil) value. Default false. Optional.

recalculationName.description: add_recalculation_dimension: name of the existing Recalculation (under the CalculationRegister given by ownerFqn) to add the dimension to.

registerDimension.description: add_recalculation_dimension: name of an existing CalculationRegister dimension that the recalculation dimension references (add it first via add_register_field kind=Dimension).

description.description: add_predefined_item: presentation/description of the predefined item (optional).

code.description: add_predefined_item: item code, a number or text by the owner's code type. Optional.

isFolder.description: add_predefined_item: create the item as a group/folder (Catalog / ChartOfCharacteristicTypes only).

accountType.description: add_predefined_item (ChartOfAccounts): Active / Passive / ActivePassive (RU aliases ok). Optional.

order.description: add_predefined_item: the account display order. set_command_placement: 0-based position within the group - omit to leave the command where it is.

characteristicType.description: add/remove_predefined_account_subconto: predefined-item name in the linked ChartOfCharacteristicTypes (the subconto value)

baseProjectName.description: Source configuration project for adopt_* operations (the extension's parent base config).

targetFqn.description: adopt_*: the child to adopt, composed from ownerFqn + childKind + name when omitted. set_role_right / set_role_restriction: the object the right or condition is set on.

rightName.description: The access right on targetFqn - Read, Insert, Update, Delete, View, Edit and the rest; Russian names are accepted and normalised.

value.description: set_role_right: grant (true) or revoke (false) the right on targetFqn. Default true.

cascadeDependencies.description: set_role_right: also grant the rights this one requires (Update needs Read, Posting needs Read and Update).

condition.description: The RLS condition body: a restriction template for set_restriction_template, a row-level condition on the right for set_role_restriction. Other role content is preserved.

objectFqn.description: delete_metadata_object: the object to remove, whole (Catalog.Products) or one child (Document.SalesOrder.Attribute.Amount). Alias of targetFqn for adopt_* operations.

childKind.description: Child kind for adopt_child: Form / Attribute / TabularSection / Template / Command / Dimension / Resource.

containerFqn.description: remove_item, move_item: the form, alias of formFqn.

parentPath.description: add_settings_group: the group to nest the new one inside, as dot-separated group names.

variantName.description: set_settings_parameter: the settings variant to work on. Omitted means the default settings, which is the first variant.

userSettingID.description: set_settings_parameter: the identifier under which the parameter appears in user settings, so BSL can set it before the report form opens.

reportAffectedSettings.description: remove_dataset, remove_dataset_field, remove_parameter, remove_calculated_field, remove_total_field (and the edit_metadata names remove_data_set, remove_data_set_field, remove_schema_parameter, remove_calculated_field, remove_total_field): list settings that still reference the removed element. Default true. The settings are left unchanged. false omits the list.

parentFqn.description: add_metadata_attribute: the object the attribute is added to, for example 'Catalog.Products' or 'Document.SalesOrder'.

newName.description: rename_metadata_object: the name to give the object.

disableIndices.description: rename_metadata_object: indices of change points to leave out, comma-separated (taken from the dry-run list).

maxResults.description: rename_metadata_object: upper bound on how many change points the dry run lists (default 20). 0 removes the cap.

scanLeftovers.description: rename_metadata_object: after the rename, list plain-text traces of the former name the refactoring leaves alone. Default true.

itemName.description: Form item name for set_property / add_form_event_handler (the field / table / button to act on).

attributeName.description: The form attribute to act on - the column's owner for add_form_attribute_column (prefer parentAttributeName), or the target of set_property on an attribute's extInfo.

parentAttributeName.description: Parent ValueTable form-attribute name for add_form_attribute_column (the column's owner). attributeName is accepted as an alias.

mainTable.description: Dynamic-list main table FQN (e.g. Catalog.Users) for add_dynamic_list_table.

commandName.description: Form command name: for add_command_handler the command to attach the handler to; for add_button an EXISTING command to reuse instead of creating <name>Command.

title.description: Title / caption for a new form element (field / group / button / table).

parentName.description: Parent container name for add_field / add_group / add_button / add_table / add_decoration (default: form root).

elementType.description: Element subtype for add_field, add_group and add_decoration.

dataPath.description: Data path binding for add_field / add_table (e.g. Object.Name).

beforeName.description: Insert the new element before this sibling element (default: append).

standardCommand.description: Bind an add_button to a platform stock command (PostAndClose / Write / Refresh / ...).

handlerName.description: BSL handler procedure name for add_form_event_handler (default derived from the event / item).

writeStub.description: add_form_event_handler / add_command_handler: append the procedure to the form module. Default true.

picture.description: Picture reference for add_decoration elementType=Picture (StdPicture.X / CommonPicture.X).

hyperlink.description: Render a Label decoration / Label field as a clickable hyperlink. Default false.

autoGenerateColumns.description: add_table with dataPath: auto-create columns for every attribute of the underlying tabular section / value table.

overwriteModel.description: repair_report_schema: replace a schema the model holds when it differs from the .dcs; the model's schema is written to a backup beside the file first. Full text: operation=help topic=parameters.

dryRun.description: Preview the operation inside a BM transaction and roll back. Default false.

confirm.description: delete_metadata_object only: applies the deletion rather than returning a preview.

cascadeForms.description: Removing an attribute, tabular section or column: also remove the form items bound to it.

batch.description: Run several operations from ONE call, in order, each in its own transaction. An operation or argument name that does not exist stops the whole batch before anything runs.

stopOnError.description: batch only: stop at the first failing operation instead of running the rest.

runKey.description: Handle to a run already going, from a previous answer that came back status=Pending.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait before answering status=Pending with a runKey instead of the result.

operations.description: batch=true payload: a JSON array of operation objects, each {"operation":<name>, ...that op's own params}.
